title: Angle Between Hands of a Clock
description: Calculate the smaller angle between the hour and minute hand of a clock.
pseudocode:
1. hour_angle = (hour % 12 + minutes / 60) * 30
2. minute_angle = minutes * 6
3. diff = abs(hour_angle - minute_angle)
4. return min(diff, 360 - diff)

steps.note: Calculate hour hand position. 12 becomes 0, plus 30 mins (0.5 hours) = 0.5 * 30 = 15 degrees.
Calculate minute hand position. 30 mins * 6 degrees/min = 180 degrees.
Return the smaller angle: min(165, 360 - 165) = min(165, 195) = 165.
